description: This is a React functional component named App that manages a light/dark theme toggle. It includes state management for the theme, an effect to apply the theme to the document, and a UI button to toggle themes while displaying current theme info. The file imports React, useState, useEffect, a logo image, and a CSS file, and exports the App component for use in a React application.

methods.name: App
methods.description: React functional component that manages and displays theme toggle UI.

methods.name: toggleTheme
methods.description: Function to switch the theme state between 'light' and 'dark'.
